title: [T-014] Complete stdin failure and interaction acceptance
body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-014 -->

Scope: textstats/cli.py and focused unit/integration checks. Depends on: T-013.

Outcome: read/decode failures identify stdin on stderr, exit 1, empty stdout, no traceback; invalid usage precedes acquisition, and complete decoded input governs text output (S-4/S-6).

Evidence: malformed piped bytes, injected binary read failure, never-close checks, --keep-bom, source/format/terminator regressions and unchanged named files. Retain named-file ranges; this task does not extend range selection to stdin.

Current accepted scope: exact text output, BOM policy and named-file ranges; JSON output/S-5 is retired. --json is usage2 before acquisition; literal --json filenames work after --. Stdin/final work remains pending; no stdin ranges.

Accepted amendment: f04f1c3da9fe6cabf92f506a422d6aa3e146078c, docs/dev/reports/phases/2/revisions/003_0e47414/REVISION-REPORT.md. Retained named-file amendment verified unit22/integration13, isolated source and9public blocks; this does not complete pending T-013–T-017.
